postToolUse.powershell: try { Set-Location -LiteralPath $env:USERPROFILE -ErrorAction Stop } catch { try { Set-Location -LiteralPath ([IO.Path]::GetPathRoot((Get-Location).Path)) -ErrorAction Stop } catch {} }; try { [IO.Directory]::SetCurrentDirectory((Get-Location).Path) } catch {}; $utf8 = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false, $true); $OutputEncoding = $utf8; [Console]::OutputEncoding = $utf8; $reader = [IO.StreamReader]::new([Console]::OpenStandardInput(), $utf8, $false); try { $raw = $reader.ReadToEnd() } finally { $reader.Dispose() }; $root = if ($env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT) { Join-Path $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT 'scripts' } elseif (-not $env:COPILOT_EXTENSIONS_CONTEXT) { Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.agent-worktrees\bin' } else { '' }; $s = if ($root) { Join-Path $root 'post-tool-hook.ps1' } else { '' }; if ($s -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $s)) { . $s; Invoke-PostToolHook -Raw $raw } else { $py = Get-Command python -CommandType Application -All -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Source -notlike '*\WindowsApps\*' } | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty Source; $fallback = if ($root) { Join-Path $root 'hook_client.py' } else { '' }; if ($py -and $fallback -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fallback)) { $raw | & $py $fallback postToolUse } else { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('agent-worktrees postToolUse: hook client unavailable') } }; exit 0
postToolUse.bash: cd "$HOME" 2>/dev/null || cd / 2>/dev/null || :; if [ -n "${COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ]; then s="$COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/hook_client.py"; elif [ -z "${COPILOT_EXTENSIONS_CONTEXT:-}" ]; then s="$HOME/.agent-worktrees/bin/hook_client.py"; else s=""; fi; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f "$s" ]; then python3 "$s" postToolUse || true; fi; exit 0

sessionStart.powershell: $r = $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT; if (-not $r -and -not $env:COPILOT_EXTENSIONS_CONTEXT) { $r = (Get-Location).Path }; try { Set-Location -LiteralPath $env:COPILOT_PROJECT_DIR -ErrorAction Stop } catch { try { Set-Location -LiteralPath $env:USERPROFILE -ErrorAction Stop } catch { try { Set-Location -LiteralPath ([IO.Path]::GetPathRoot((Get-Location).Path)) -ErrorAction Stop } catch {} } }; try { [IO.Directory]::SetCurrentDirectory((Get-Location).Path) } catch {}; $s = if ($r) { Join-Path $r 'scripts\hook_client.py' } else { '' }; if ((-not $s -or -not (Test-Path $s)) -and -not $env:COPILOT_EXTENSIONS_CONTEXT) { $s = "$env:USERPROFILE\.agent-worktrees\bin\hook_client.py" }; $py = Get-Command python -CommandType Application -All -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Source -notlike '*\WindowsApps\*' } | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty Source; $utf8 = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false); $OutputEncoding = $utf8; [Console]::OutputEncoding = $utf8; $reader = [IO.StreamReader]::new([Console]::OpenStandardInput(), $utf8, $false); try { $raw = $reader.ReadToEnd() } finally { $reader.Dispose() }; $ran = $false; if ($py -and $s -and (Test-Path $s)) { $raw | & $py $s sessionStart; $ran = ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) }; if (-not $ran) { $a = if ($s) { Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $s) 'managed-session.ps1' } else { '' }; $admitted = $false; if ($a -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $a)) { . $a; $admitted = Test-ManagedWorktreesSession -Raw $raw }; $b = if ($s) { Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $s) 'bootstrap-check.ps1' } else { '' }; if ($admitted -and $b -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $b)) { & $b } else { [Console]::Out.Write('{}') } }
sessionStart.bash: r="${COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; if [ -z "$r" ] && [ -z "${COPILOT_EXTENSIONS_CONTEXT:-}" ]; then r="$PWD"; fi; cd "${COPILOT_PROJECT_DIR:-$HOME}" 2>/dev/null || cd "$HOME" 2>/dev/null || cd / 2>/dev/null || :; if [ -n "$r" ]; then s="$r/scripts/hook_client.py"; else s=""; fi; if [ ! -f "$s" ] && [ -z "${COPILOT_EXTENSIONS_CONTEXT:-}" ]; then s="$HOME/.agent-worktrees/bin/hook_client.py"; fi; raw="$(cat)"; ran=false; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f "$s" ]; then if printf '%s' "$raw" | python3 "$s" sessionStart; then ran=true; fi; fi; if [ "$ran" != true ]; then a="${s%/*}/managed_session.py"; b="${s%/*}/bootstrap-check.sh"; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f "$a" ] && [ -f "$b" ] && printf '%s' "$raw" | python3 -I -B "$a" --check; then bash "$b"; else printf '{}'; fi; fi

sessionEnd.bash: cd "$HOME" 2>/dev/null || cd / 2>/dev/null || :; if [ -n "${COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ]; then s="$COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/deregister-session.sh"; elif [ -z "${COPILOT_EXTENSIONS_CONTEXT:-}" ]; then s="$HOME/.agent-worktrees/bin/deregister-session.sh"; else s=""; fi; if [ -f "$s" ]; then bash "$s" || true; else printf '%s\n' '[agent-worktrees] SessionEnd client unavailable; closure is unconfirmed.' >&2; fi
